failures.name: Shipping confused with billing

failures.name: Shipping misclassified as account access
failures.description: Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context.

failures.name: Product question misclassified as billing
failures.description: Model treats plan change or feature availability questions as billing issues when pricing or plan names are mentioned.

playbook.text:
House rules, learned from labelled examples:
- Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping keywords like 'add', 'support', 'plan'. These go to feedback, not product_question.
- Model incorrectly tags positive feedback about shipping speed/packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback. These go to feedback, not shipping.
- Model mislabels shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) as billing when payment timing or transaction context is mentioned. These go to shipping, not billing.
- Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context. These go to shipping, not account_access.
- Model treats plan change or feature availability questions as billing issues when pricing or plan names are mentioned. These go to product_question, not billing.

Worked examples:
Ticket: Hey team, it would be great if offline mode supported more file types. Cheers
Label: feedback
Ticket: Can you bring back the old widget? The new one is harder to use. Thanks.
Label: feedback
Ticket: Please add export to PDF to the Team plan, my whole team would use it. Thanks.
Label: feedback

Label: feedback

Label: shipping

Label: shipping

Label: shipping

Label: shipping

Label: product_question

Label: product_question

events.text: 230 examples to learn from, 64 checks for tuning, 120 held out for the test. 8 labels.
Running live on Nebius Token Factory.
Base Nemotron 3 Nano got 89 of 120 held-out tickets right (74%).
Nemotron 3 Ultra scored 90% at $0.196 per 1,000 calls: the bar to chase.
Nemotron 3 Super found 5 failure types in 9 mistakes on the tuning checks.
Feedback misclassified as product question: Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping keywords like 'add', 'support', 'plan'.
Feedback misclassified as shipping: Model incorrectly tags positive feedback about shipping speed/packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback.
Shipping confused with billing: Model mislabels shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) as billing when payment timing or transaction context is mentioned.
Shipping misclassified as account access: Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context.
Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote 131 cases; Nemotron 3 Super agreed with 123. 8 dropped.
Wrote a playbook for Nemotron 3 Nano: 5 house rules and 10 worked examples from the agreed cases.
Taught Nemotron 3 Nano got 104 of 120 right (87%), up from 74%.
Shipped. Taught beats base by 15 of 120 held-out tickets (74% to 87%). Endpoint: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B + playbook.

failures.name: Feedback misclassified as shipping
failures.description: Model incorrectly tags positive feedback about shipping speed/packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback.

failures.name: Shipping confused with billing
failures.description: Model mislabels shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) as billing when payment timing or transaction context is mentioned.

failures.name: Shipping misclassified as account access
failures.description: Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context.

failures.name: Product question misclassified as billing
failures.description: Model treats plan change or feature availability questions as billing issues when pricing or plan names are mentioned.

playbook.text:
House rules, learned from labelled examples:
- Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping keywords like 'add', 'support', 'plan'. These go to feedback, not product_question.
- Model incorrectly tags positive feedback about shipping speed/packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback. These go to feedback, not shipping.
- Model mislabels shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) as billing when payment timing or transaction context is mentioned. These go to shipping, not billing.
- Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context. These go to shipping, not account_access.
- Model treats plan change or feature availability questions as billing issues when pricing or plan names are mentioned. These go to product_question, not billing.

- Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping keywords like 'add', 'support', 'plan'. These go to feedback, not product_question.
- Model incorrectly tags positive feedback about shipping speed/packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback. These go to feedback, not shipping.
- Model mislabels shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) as billing when payment timing or transaction context is mentioned. These go to shipping, not billing.
- Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context. These go to shipping, not account_access.
- Model treats plan change or feature availability questions as billing issues when pricing or plan names are mentioned. These go to product_question, not billing.

Worked examples:
Ticket: Hey team, it would be great if offline mode supported more file types. Cheers
Label: feedback
Ticket: Can you bring back the old widget? The new one is harder to use. Thanks.
Label: feedback
Ticket: Please add export to PDF to the Team plan, my whole team would use it. Thanks.
Label: feedback
Ticket: Good morning. Any plans to support Galaxy S23? I would switch my whole team over. Appreciate it.
Label: feedback
Ticket: My order #LUM-8842 shows delivered but nothing at my door. Need tracking help.
Label: shipping
Ticket: My replacement device hasn't moved in 5 days — tracking stuck at 'label created'.
Label: shipping
Ticket: Parcel marked delivered but received empty padded mailer. Need investigation.
Label: shipping
Ticket: Need a return label for the defective dock — RMA approved but no email yet.
Label: shipping
Ticket: What file formats does the Pro plan export support right now?
Label: product_question
Ticket: Does the Team plan include admin analytics or is that a separate add-on?
Label: product_question

e.text: Shipped. Taught beats base by 15 of 120 held-out tickets (74% to 87%). Endpoint: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B + playbook.
